definitions.explanation: An informal, affectionate term for one's mother. Used primarily by young children, though also used by adults in casual family settings or to refer warmly to a motherly figure.

examples.japanese: お{母|かあ}ちゃん、⟦おなかすいた→おなかすいた：17649_onakasuita⟧。
お{母|かあ}ちゃん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧おいしい。
⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、つい「お{母|かあ}ちゃん」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧しまう。
examples.english: Even as an adult, I end up calling her 'okaachan' without thinking.

notes:
A casual, affectionate variant of ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧, formed by replacing さん with the diminutive ちゃん. Commonly used by young children and in warm, informal family contexts.

REGISTER:
More casual and childlike than ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧. Some adults continue using it in private, though it sounds childish in formal settings. Has a warm, down-to-earth nuance.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧: mother — the standard polite form
- ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧: mama — modern, widely used by young children and in casual settings
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧: mother — humble form used when speaking about one's own mother to others
- ⟦おふくろ→おふくろ：10246_ofukuro⟧: one's mother — masculine, colloquial term used by adult men
- お{母|かあ}ちゃん has a more traditional, working-class, or regional flavor compared to ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧
